definition: what the recovery has actually looked like so far, phase by phase

settled:
Through 2025 the baseline was rest. Books, games and shows on my own and nothing else, with whatever surge I had going into my work. Some of the time even the resting cost more than I had.

Early in 2026 it changed in kind rather than in degree. Programming became affordable, and twelve-hour coding days held for four months from there.

What unlocked it was my baseline safety crossing into the rung where I can be productive. At that rung programming stops costing me a multiplier at all.

The crossing is the event. The months of rest and the better interventions are what raised the baseline to it.

title: The Two Phases Of Coming Back
